news.headline: A 20-Year-Old Becomes the Youngest F1 Champion Ever
news.body: Kimi Antonelli from Italy is the new Formula 1 world champion! He finished third at the Mexico City Grand Prix on Sunday, which was plenty to win the title for the whole season. At just 20 years old, he is the youngest F1 champion in history. He's also the first driver from Italy to win it in 73 years. Even the race winner, Max Verstappen, called it "incredible."

news.headline: Meet Marigold, a Brand-New Baby Orangutan
news.body: A zoo in Fresno, California, has a new baby Sumatran orangutan! She is about four weeks old and is starting to explore her home with her mom, Negara. Zookeepers named her Marigold, after a bright orange flower that stands for the sun. Sumatran orangutans are very rare in the wild, so every new baby is a big deal.

news.headline: Twin Spacecraft Get Ready to Slingshot to Mars
news.body: NASA has two twin spacecraft called ESCAPADE that are heading to Mars. This weekend, each one will swing close to Earth and fire its engine, using Earth's gravity like a slingshot to speed toward Mars. They'll be going so fast they could fly across the United States in less than 7 minutes! They should reach Mars next September.

fun_fact: The word orangutan means "person of the forest" in the Malay language. Orangutans spend most of their lives up in the trees! 🌳

did_you_know: Orangutans build a brand-new bed of leaves and branches high up in the trees almost every night. Some even add a leafy roof when it rains! 🍃
